offering_description.value: Buys portfolios of charged-off consumer debt from banks and lenders at a discount and collects them from consumers. It recovers balances through call centers, digital outreach, payment plans and external law firms.

primary_services.value: debt collection; legal collection; portfolio recovery; collection agency services

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers repaying charged-off credit card, auto and other consumer debts

revenue_model.value: other: collections on purchased charged-off consumer debt portfolios; service fees: fees for contingency collection work on accounts for other clients

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in charged-off consumer receivables bought from banks and lenders; service provider: provides collection services on accounts for third-party clients

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide across the United States, collecting from consumers in all states

specialization.value: niche specialist: charged-off consumer debt purchasing and recovery

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated call centers and offices that contact debtors; partners / resellers: external law firms and agencies handling legal collections; online: online payment portal and digital account resolution tools for consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state collection agency licenses and consumer protection rules under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, enforced by the CFPB and state regulators

notes: Non-US operations may have been divested, so this description focuses on the US business.
